S1:12.text: The ſonnes of Iuda Her and Onan & Sela and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan And there were ſonnes borne to Phares: Heſron and Hamul.

S1:31.text: But he ſpake to his brethren, and to al his fathers houſe I wil goe vp, and wil tel Pharao, and will ſay to him: My brethren, and my fathers houſe, that were in the Land of Chanaan, are come to me:

S1:33.text: And when he ſhal cal you, and ſhal ſay What is your trade?

S6:16.text: The ſonnes of Gad Sephion and Haggi and Siuni & Eſebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.

S6:22.text: theſe be the ſonnes of Rachel, which ſhe bare to Iacob al the ſoules, fourteen.

S6:24.text: The ſonnes of Nepthali: Iazicl and Guni and Ieſer and Sallem.

S6:25.text: Theſe be the ſonnes of Bala, whom Laban gaue to Rachel his daughter: and theſe ſhe bare to Iacob al the ſoules, ſeuen.

S9:1.text: and Iſrael taking his iourney, with al things that he had " came to the wel of the oath, and killing there victimes to the God of his father. Iſaac.

S9:16.text: The ſonnes of Gad Sephion and Haggi and Siuni and Eſebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.

S9:17.text: The ſonnes of Aſer Iamne and Ieſua and Ieſſui and Beria, Sara alſo their ſiſter. The ſonnes of Beria Heber and Melchiel.

S9:22.text: theſe be the ſonnes of Rachel, which ſhe bare to Iacob: al the ſoules, fourtene

S9:24.text: The ſonnes of Nepthali Iaziel and Guni and Ieſer and Sallem.

S9:26.text: Al the ſoules, that entred with Iacob into Ægypt, and that came out of his thighe, beſides his ſonnes wiues, ſixtie ſix.

S9:27.text: And the ſonnes of Ioſeph, that were borne to him in the land of Ægypt, two ſoules. Al the ſoules of the houſe of Iacob, that entred into Ægypt, were ſeuentie.

S9:28.text: And he ſent Iudas before him to Ioſeph, that he ſhould tel him, and he ſhould come into Geſſen to meete him

S9:33.text: And when he ſhal cal you, and ſhal ſay What is your trade?
